_help: Settings for `npm run video -- ideas` and the UI's Ideas page. keywords decide what counts as on-topic (generic words like 'model' only count next to a specific one). youtube.channels are reference channels scanned for outliers (views ÷ the channel's median ≥ minMultiple); add a channel by its UC… id. Set YOUTUBE_API_KEY to use the official API (2 quota units per channel) instead of reading the channel page. Leave out a source to switch it off. maxAgeDays drops anything older; batchSize is how many ideas one run returns.
